parties.respondent: State of NCT of Delhi and Anr.

summary: Appeal against High Court's bail order for Respondent No.2 (Jayant Kumar Jain, MD of M/s Aranath Logistics) in FIR involving siphoning Rs.25 crores via shell companies under IPC Sections 409, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120B. High Court granted bail noting commercial dispute nature and documentary evidence seizure. Appellant alleged systematic fraud including forged KYC documents, fund diversion to fake entities, and prior liability settlement. Court examined bail cancellation based on accused's misuse of liberty and serious allegations despite settlement attempt.
legal_provisions_cited: Dolat Ram vs. State of Haryana, (1995) 1 SCC 349
X vs. State of Telangana, (2018) 16 SCC 511
Prabhakar Tewari vs. State of U.P., (2020) 11 SCC 648
Gurcharan Singh vs. State (Delhi Administration) (1978) 1 SCC 118
final_judgment: Pending disposal after withdrawal attempt of Special Leave Petition due to settlement, but court expressed disinclination considering seriousness of fraud allegations.
